fusions.name: Snag and Reel
fusions.desc: Snags a target up to 7 tiles away with a barbed gust that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and reels you up to 7 tiles to it. The target moves 20% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses 3 barbed gusts at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Bristling Catch
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
